comment: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. Neither jack is given a family: the module scales and offsets whatever is patched to it, so a colour would be a guess. The knob defaults to +1 rather than to the centre (line 32), so a new ATT-01 passes its input at full level. The ±12V clamp at line 58 is the only limiting in the module.
